oneLine: Protectt.ai plans to acquire a controlling stake in Bosch's AIShield.

sources.title: Protectt.ai To Acquire Controlling Stake In Bosch’s AIShield

synopsis: Enterprise cybersecurity startup Protectt.ai plans to acquire a controlling, majority stake in AIShield, an AI security platform incubated within Bosch Global Software Technologies. Bosch will retain a minority stake in AIShield following the transaction. The deal structure comprises primary and secondary components, combining cash and ESOPs along with future investments as required. The companies have not disclosed the specific transaction value or timeline. AIShield will operate as an independent entity under Protectt.ai with its own professional management team.
